anomalies.observed: The PCA9685PW (U2) address pins A0-A5 are all tied to GND, which sets its I2C address to 0x40. The INA219AIDCNR (U1) also has A0 and A1 tied to GND, setting its address to 0x40. Both devices are on the same I2C2 bus (I2C2_SCL_FCC / I2C2_SDA_FCC).
anomalies.expected: The PCA9685PW should be at a different address from the INA219. The schematic note on U2 says 'I2C address: 0x41', indicating the intended address is 0x41 (A0 high), which would avoid the conflict.

evidence.quote: U2 PCA9685PW ... I2C address: 0x41 (FCC Peripherals sheet)
PWM/servo driver | FCCPeripherals | NXP PCA9685PW (I2C 16-ch PWM), I2C addr 0x40

anomalies.impact: If both devices respond at 0x40, I2C transactions to the PWM driver and the current/voltage monitor will collide, making one or both devices inaccessible or causing bus contention.

parsed.summary: The schematic is largely consistent with the specification, but the PCA9685PW address pins appear tied to GND (0x40) while the note and the co-located INA219 indicate a conflict; this is the only candidate deviation found.
